component.name: MultiFlexi Semaphore
component.summary: Semaphore UI REST API credential prototype for MultiFlexi

description.p: Provides the Semaphore credential prototype for MultiFlexi core, defining the SEMAPHORE_URL and SEMAPHORE_TOKEN configuration fields required to trigger Ansible playbooks as Semaphore tasks (e.g. SaaS provisioning).
Also ships a web UI component that probes /api/user with the configured token and displays the token owner.
